title: Chapter 302: Cunning Undead
content:
Chapter 302: Cunning Undead

More than one hundred bronze crossbow carts, with full firepower, covered most of the battlefield.

The cavalry of Wang Shuo and others also lined up in formation, ready to charge at any time.

"Brother Wang, I am really sorry for the last battle."

Su Xiu rode over and stood in front of Wang Shuo, a little embarrassed.

Although Wang Shuo despised him in his heart, he also understood him very well and said lightly: "Brother Su, don't mind. If I were in your position, I would probably make the same choice."

Wang Shuo had no expression on his face and didn't want to say more.

Su Xiu didn't say anything else. With the enemy at hand, he must avenge his previous shame this time.

After the last defeat, he immediately recruited 1,000 soldiers in Jiuyuan Town and added them to the White Horse Knights, and the number of people was restored to 3,000.

The loud horn sounded, and the undead army launched an attack.

Wang Shuo also led the Red Flame Army and began to charge.

Ayub started the "Long Snake Formation". The four fierce generals of Wana Town acted as the snake heads. A low-level undead general who rushed to the front was killed on the spot by Wang Shuo and his four men.

The Red Flame Army was invincible.

Just as Wang Shuo and others started the battle, Lin Xiaodong also opened the city gate and sent out the elite infantry of Changping County to start the counterattack.

The army of Changping County is all level 60, well-equipped, covered with heavy armor, and the defense has reached a terrifying 800 points.

Every soldier has such a high defense, all thanks to the mithril black gold armor on them.

This kind of armor is higher than the gold armor and belongs to the rare level. Each set is worth a lot of money. Changping County only has 2,000 sets.

But the combat power of these 2,000 people makes Lin Xiaodong confident that he can defeat the ace troops of the undead army.

After the heavy infantry left the city, the bloodthirsty demon wolf hiding in the distance laughed strangely.

Behind him, hundreds of generals gathered, some intermediate and some advanced.

The low-level and top-level generals were sent by him to encircle and suppress the human army outside, while he took the most elite undead warriors and a group of intermediate and advanced generals to ambush and prepare to attack the troops coming out of Changping County.

Everything was progressing according to the script he designed.

When the heavy infantry of Changping County entered the ambush circle, he immediately gave the order and launched an attack.

The Chiyan Army led by Wang Shuo also had a smooth journey at this time, and there was no enemy wherever they passed.

This made him a little confused.

The undead knights encountered before were quite powerful, but these undead were too weak.

The bronze crossbow carts on the hills also shot out spears wantonly, slaughtering the skeleton army.

After a rush, Wang Shuo was upgraded again.

At this point in the battle, he had not encountered a decent opponent, such as Falati.

After killing more than half of the 50,000 undead army on the opposite side, Wagner saw that the situation was not right and immediately ordered a retreat.

After chasing for a distance, Wang Shuo and others did not pursue them relentlessly.

There was a canyon ahead, and Wang Shuo was also worried that the other party would use his tactics to deal with him. If there was an ambush, the whole army would be wiped out.

At this time, Wang Shuo got the news.

The main force of Changping County was ambushed by the undead army and wiped out.

Wang Shuo's heart trembled. It turned out that the enemy had made a feint to the east and attacked in the west.

It's not simple. They actually used tactics.

Wang Shuo put away his contempt.

"Mayor Wang, I wonder what you think about the destruction of the main force of County Magistrate Lin?"

Zheng Zhongji came to Wang Shuo and said with some concern.

Before Wang Shuo spoke, the mayors of the nearby towns gathered around.

Obviously, they also got the news.

Here, Wang Shuo's troops were the most outstanding, killing the most enemies on the battlefield. His strength was recognized by everyone, and there was a tendency to regard him as the backbone.

Wang Shuo saw everyone coming and talked on horseback, which was not a big deal.

So he set up a big tent and invited everyone into the big tent to discuss matters.
